parsed.why: No trans-specific offence and no documented police targeting; gender-identity anti-discrimination and hate-crime aggravation in force, majority (53-64%) support. Dated impunity record and weak enforcement of protections, but no traveller-facing restriction documented.

No criminalisation, but the vague 'acts against nature' article is used as a police extortion pretext; no gender-identity protection or hate-crime recourse, hostile attitudes (73% would dislike a homosexual neighbour), violence by state and family actors.

State-imposed universal exposure: marker-restrictive passports, X-marker halted, entry refusal and lifetime-ineligibility risk, foreign nationals detained; facility bans criminalised in four states; immigration-custody abuse. Only contested courts and some protective states mitigate.

Documented police sweeps detaining trans women for ID checks (299 detention decisions in 2025), no gender-identity protection, birth-sex custody with strip-searches and a death in custody, attacker freed while victim prosecuted.

Working remedy: gender-identity protection since 2013 with damages awarded 2024, hate-crime law covering gender identity, custody placement by lived gender. Facilities/records friction and no enforcement data, but no criminalisation or state targeting.
